nodes.label: Stock Means Earned
nodes.rationale: Card stock is what the product's real material sits on; an unbuilt feature (the Arena) is a hairline strip on the table, never a Panel.

nodes.label: Foil Is Earned-Only
nodes.rationale: Foil appears only on legendary and is never decoration; if adding foil is only to make something look good, the answer is no.

nodes.label: The Frame Carries the Rarity, Not a Stripe
nodes.rationale: A 3px coloured side rail was the first draft; the craft floor refused any coloured border above 1px as one of the most recognisable tells of a generated interface.

nodes.label: Amber Means Money
nodes.rationale: coin and legendary share a hue deliberately, but amber on any figure means it is literally Study Coins; a streak is coral because a run of days is not a balance.

nodes.label: Legacy Token Aliases (violet/cyan/lime/rose/amber/panel)
nodes.rationale: Repointed rather than renamed so roughly 174 files could re-theme from one file with no chance of a screen being missed; treated as read-only compatibility, never extended.

nodes.label: Technical Gotchas (theme inline, Tailwind scan, heartbeat deps)
nodes.rationale: @theme inline does not emit real CSS custom properties; Tailwind only generates classes present as literal source text, so template-interpolated class names silently fail; and putting pathname in the heartbeat effect's deps rebuilds it on every navigation, producing a wave of 429s.

nodes.label: NavigationProvider
nodes.rationale: Holds the pending destination so the sidebar highlight and loading skeleton move immediately on click; its capture-phase click listener and CSS-hidden-sibling skeleton must not be undone.

nodes.label: Skeleton Shaped Like the Page
nodes.rationale: A skeleton that does not occupy the same box as the real content is decoration; the page still jumps when data lands, so every route's loading.tsx must be shaped like the page it stands in for.

nodes.label: StatStrip Component
nodes.rationale: How any screen summarises a thing as one divided panel rather than four separate cards, because four cards say 'unrelated numbers' while one divided frame says 'the state of this thing'.

nodes.label: PRODUCT_NAME / MAIL_FROM_NAME (brand.ts)
nodes.rationale: The product name is not settled; every user-facing occurrence reads from these exports so renaming is one line plus a new glyph.

nodes.label: Card Frames (design system name)
nodes.rationale: Replaces 'Ink & Gold', the previous monochrome graphite-and-gold system; nothing in Card Frames is inherited from it unless stated.
